proposed_statement_changes.proposed: Under \texttt{ass:event-date-transport}, \texttt{ass:design-conditional-centering}, and the disclosed one-direction condition \texttt{ass:attainable-local-modulus}, for every growth array with \(N\wedge T\wedge\min_s n_s\to\infty\), the interval \(C_\alpha=[\widehat\tau-R_\alpha,\widehat\tau+R_\alpha]\cap[-2B,2B]\) on the regular branch, and \(C_\alpha=[-2B,2B]\) under every declared bad-sample convention, satisfies \[\liminf\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}}\Pr_P\{\tau(z_0)\in C_\alpha\mid z_0\}\ge1-\alpha,\qquad\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}}\mathbb E_P[\operatorname{length}(C_\alpha)\mid z_0]\le C R_{\star}^{1/2}.\] The proof must uniformly bound the probability of fewer than two usable blocks, undefined variance denominators, donor-covariance small samples, empty opposite-parity fits, and \(\mathsf F_{\mathrm{fb}}\), and must include the full-range interval's length on those events. Conversely, every interval with the same uniform conditional coverage has worst-case conditional expected length at least \(cR_{\star}^{1/2}\). The \(N^{-\kappa/2}\) expected-length converse, and hence the four-channel length equivalence, uses the maintained direction. The separated calendar-block construction uses actual local-polynomial weights and the full spectrally clipped \(\widehat\Sigma\), and incurs no multiplicative logarithmic phase.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The larger frozen class permits design-dependent conditional means and is refuted by the common-design-shock witness. The newly directed sampling-centering condition removes exactly that observed-law obstruction while preserving the original causal estimand, event-date transport, unrestricted within-unit training/event dependence beyond the two conditional-mean restrictions, all four rate channels, and the positive honest-length claim. The explicit growth condition makes the displayed limit well typed. This unit does not replace the frontier by the larger-class obstruction.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The positive honest-length theorem must use the repaired model class, causal identification, the corrected factorization that preserves within-unit dependence, samplewise totalization, the conditional and marginal frontiers, and the two-sided proxy modulus. The obsolete dependence on the common-design-shock obstruction is removed because that lemma concerns only the larger class obtained by deleting design-conditional centering.
